verdict.headline: liquidations = mature utility market of ~20 EVM teams + a handful of Solana shops; three sequential taxes on margin (builders/tips 60-86%, SVR 73% recapture / 173 bps Aave take, dutch auctions); infrastructure bar $1.8-3.8K/mo (Solana) with managed tooling dead (Gelato, Defender); semi-passive solo is structurally impossible: asset is either dust (needs machine-gun automation) or cascade (needs war-readiness)
verdict.rational_solo_play: 'firefighter capital': stables + monitoring for depegs/cascades - USDe $0.65 (+54% <1 day, Oct-2025), rsETH 0.85 (+11-25% in 25 days, Apr-May 2026), USDC $0.87 (+15% in 2 days, 2023); frequency 1-2x/yr; main risk = mistaking a true default (UST) for a panic depeg
verdict.realistic_yields_discussed: majors: negative after infra (operator: <$2 net per liquidation, $1-2K per crash window); long-tail: $0-2K/mo, 0-30%/yr optimistic; community datapoints: 1/3 bots ~breakeven, ~30% losers
